question: Do the six final baseline world models solve the unchanged B001 latent-goal planning tasks when the complete evaluations run on spare CPUs?
hypothesis: Physical readout differences may or may not translate into planning success; strong L0 performance and failure of L1 advantage are valid outcomes.

sources.consequence: Keep the original final elite mean and squared terminal latent cost. This baseline-only CPU adaptation does not change object matching or adopt different paper hyperparameters.

Externally bound each owned CPU child, confirm exit, preserve partial files and require separate operational review before successors.

differences: CPU execution adaptation of six already-planned seed0 B001 baseline evaluations while the GPU object encoder trains. No neural training, new calibration/data/controls or test-driven planner changes. Full3000-case outputs retain C002 schema and explicitly identify CPU hardware. No object-model or extra-seed execution is authorized by this record.
contrary_evidence: Probe accessibility does not establish useful latent distance or planning. Physical supervision may fail, and the local baseline already differs from the reference paper. CPU/GPU roundoff can change CEM elite choices. One training seed does not establish generalization; episode intervals omit training-seed uncertainty. White-ball contacts are absent from local dynamics.

protocol.parents: Actual passed A003/A015/A016 final lineage,303000,seed0,float64/math/inference-only. Bind exact reviewed C006 test bytes and B001 controls/cases/source. Each run requires its own substantive preconsultation with checkpoint,parent,data and B001/B003 record digests. Prior CPU cases need separate scientific and operational reviews.
protocol.tasks: Exactly all1000 existing test episodes at each horizon4/6/8, five groups of200. Use unchanged task_start seed2026111503 and CEM seed2026111504. Three history images and two past executed actions; goal encoded independently. No intermediate future frames or labels enter the model. Labels enter only simulator scoring.
protocol.planner: Unchanged learned_actions/cem:100 candidates,10 elites,20 iterations,std2,action norm cap3,minimum std0.001,final elite mean. Squared terminal latent distance. No replanning, auxiliary geometric cost, warm start or optimizer tuning.
protocol.scoring: Unchanged red_path/score, primary red endpoint error<=1pixel; collision-free endpoint success secondary with discrete-frame white distances. Save all actions and episode/start/goal/CEM identities. Reuse summarize2000 episode bootstrap per horizon and group breakdown; retain seed0 separately.
protocol.numerics: Before complete iteration for every model, fixed episode0 H8 first100 proposal batch: finite predicted latents and costs, first8 singleton and reversed100 grouping at rtol1e-4/atol1e-5. Preserve diagnostic arrays. Keep all learned parameters/buffers frozen; verify final data/source/checkpoint hashes and no CUDA initialization. No GPU equality claim.
protocol.software_checks: Exact CPU adapter versus original _evaluate on synthetic two-episode/all-horizon data with recording fake model, comparing all fields except latency. Independently verify scoring flags and endpoint error, retained2000-bootstrap summaries, task uniqueness, source identity, preconsultation mismatch rejection and actual six-parent lineage. Inherit unchanged B002 planner and A016 owned-process checks, without claiming actual GPU coverage.
protocol.execution: One eight-thread CPU child with one interop thread, hidden HIP/CUDA/ROCR. Per model7200seconds including15seconds cleanup, RSS<=16GiB; all six at most43200seconds. New immutable output paths, file logs, exact child identity, no GPU ledger rows or signals to other processes. Canonical scientific outputs planning/RUN; operational outputs B003/operations/RUN. Preserve partial cases on deadline and mark incomplete; no automatic retry/review/successor.
protocol.review: Review each actual scientific and operational result after substantive literature consultation before the next model. Inspect complete cases and independently recalculate scores/summaries/task pairing. Success direction is not a software gate; measured negatives remain in final comparison.

success: Complete valid3000-case evaluation per model with reviewed results, independent raw-case checks and correct uncertainty. No required ranking for measurement validity; original C002 reference/planning bars remain unchanged.
stop: Stale lineage/source/data, invalid candidate numerics, nonfinite output, device initialization, memory/time exhaustion or failed controls stops the case. Preserve artifacts. No threshold/precision/planner/split adjustment after observing results.
